continuity.arc_goal: Add complete linked workflow support to the Rust SDK with typed completion handlers, compile-time validation, awaitable child results, and full protocol integration

progress_update.summary: We completed the on_completion API with full compile-time enforcement via ObjectContextT, implemented the server-side JSON Result envelope for completion handler arguments, added serde derives to TerminalError, made start_linked() return a DurableFuture (selectable) that resolves to LinkedInvocation, and added LinkedInvocation::result() for awaiting child completion. Also fixed the shared-core to return LinkHandle from sys_link. Multiple repos touched: sdk-rust, sdk-shared-core, restate server.
progress_update.goal: Add complete linked workflow support to the Rust SDK with typed completion handlers, compile-time validation, awaitable child results, and full protocol integration
accomplished: Implemented ObjectContextT + RunRequestT + WorkflowClientT + RunT for typed completion handlers with same-object enforcement

Removed on_completion from default RunRequest path — only available via ObjectContextT

start_linked() returns impl DurableFuture<Output = Result<LinkedInvocation, TerminalError>> — awaitable and selectable

DurableFuture + SealedDurableFuture impls for TrapFuture and Either to support select!
Comprehensive code review — addressed C1/C2 (serde), H1 (runtime panic), renamed types to T-suffix convention
5 trybuild negative compile tests for on_completion
